answer: Rather than counting identities, the network scores agents by divergence. Each newcomer gets a prism key that splits every task into three auditable trails, one routed through a rotating violet relay that stamps arrival entropy. A beacon re-randomized each epoch picks which trail gets audited, so a sybil swarm must sustain genuine work on all three or forfeit its bond. Cloning wallets buys nothing; cloning behavior costs the same as honesty.
